I'm sorry to call you here when you're busy.
strings.잠깐 짬을 내서 왔어요. 레나 씨가 잠깐 쉬고 있으라 그랬는데, 그냥 가: I had a little time. Lena told me to rest, but I couldn't just sit still.
strings.레나 씨라면 은의 발톱의 레나 하이렌 경 말하는 건가요?: Lena? Dame Lena Highren of the Silver Claw?
Yes. She's staying at the Guild Alliance inn.
strings.여관에 계시다면 분명 술을 드시고 계시겠죠. 폐하의 칙서라도 가져오신 걸: If she's at the inn, she must be drinking. Did she bring a royal decree?
Yes. She told me to wait a little.
strings.(시이나가 저 멀리서 %s의 모습을 발견하고 뛰어온다.): (Shiina spots %s in the distance and runs over.)
strings.마침 모험가님 생각을 했는데, 여기서 이렇게 볼 줄이야. 제가 많이 보고: I was just thinking of you. I didn't expect to see you here! I must have missed you terribly.
strings.고, 고마워요…. 이렇게 절 격하게 환영하는 사람은 정말 오랜만인 것 같: Th-thank you... It's been a while since anyone welcomed me so enthusiastically.
strings.며칠 안 됐는데, 보고 싶다고 말씀하실 정도면 시이나가 모험가님을 많이: It's only been a few days. If you missed the adventurer already, you must be very fond of them, Shiina.
strings.네, 맞아요. 모험가님이라면 그럴 자격이 있으니까요. 헤헷,: I am! The adventurer deserves it. Hehe.
I don't recall my junior greeting me quite so enthusiastically when I arrived...
strings.선배님, 그때는 학교가 엉망이었잖아요! 대신 이렇게 안아드릴게요. 이제: The school was a mess then! Here, I'll hug you instead. Better now?
strings.보기 좋은 모습이에요. 아, 맞다. 소레이유, 저한테 뭔가 부탁할게 있는: It's nice to see. Oh, right. Soleil, didn't you need a favor?
strings.다름 아니라 요즘 플라티나와 연락이 되지 않아서요. 어디서 무엇을 하고: I haven't been able to contact Platina lately. I don't know where she is or what she's doing.
strings.벨파 도서관에서 몇 번 보기는 했는데…. 저도 그 후론 보지 못했던 거: I've seen her a few times at Belpha Library... But not since then.
strings.플라티나가 어디 있는지 찾아봐 주시겠어요? 플라티나가 잠시 보이지 않을: Could you find her? Whenever she disappears for a while, something has happened.
It might even give you a clue about Her Majesty's decree.
Oh, now I'm curious. I'll look into both, then.
strings.(그러면 누구에게 알아봐야 하나…. 아, 일단 길드 여관의 세라에게 가보: (Whom should I ask...? I'll start with Sera at the Guild inn.)
strings.뭘요, 소레이유. 그러면 어디 가지 말고 제가 올때까지 여기서 기다리세요: Of course, Soleil. Stay here until I return. I'll be back.
I will. There's still work to do before the school is in order.
strings.(소레이유와 시이나가 %s의 모습이 멀리 사라질 때까지 배웅한다.): (Soleil and Shiina see %s off until the adventurer vanishes into the distance.)
strings.칙서라…. 언니가 모험가님께 뭔가 부탁하는 걸까요?: A decree... Is my sister asking the adventurer for something?
I don't know, but it seems important.
strings.별 일 아니었으면 좋겠지만, 아무래도 평범한 일은 아니겠죠?: I hope it's nothing serious, though it can't be ordinary business.
strings.평범한 일은 아니겠지만, 너무 걱정하지 말아요. %s 님께서 다 잘 하실: Probably not. But don't worry. %s will handle it well.
Then, Shiina, shall we get back to tidying up? There's plenty left.
strings.으, 바쁘다, 바빠. 음식 재료도 구해야 하고, 텅 빈 통나무 맥주 케그: Ugh, busy, busy. Ingredients to buy, empty wooden beer kegs to fill...
strings.급여를 받아야 하는데, 선배는 어디 간다는 말도 없이 며칠 째 소식도 없: And I need my pay, but my senior vanished days ago without saying where she was going...
strings.(세라가 잠시 정신줄을 놓은 듯하다.): (Sera seems to switch off for a moment.)
Yes. I've been standing here for a little while...
Oh, sorry. I've been so busy I can't think straight.
I understand. Too much work can do that.
strings.뭔가 필요하신 거 있으세요? 말씀하세요. 여관에 머무시는 동안엔 최고의: Do you need anything? Just say the word. You'll have the best service while staying here.
strings.(세라의 영업용 미소가 너무 눈부셔 눈을 제대로 뜰 수 없을 정도다.): (Sera's sales smile is so dazzling you can barely keep your eyes open.)
strings.(세라에게 플라티나를 찾고 있다고 설명한다.): (You explain that you're looking for Platina.)
strings.(세라가 갑자기 눈을 반짝이며 %s의 두 손을 잡는다.): (Sera's eyes suddenly sparkle, and she grasps %s's hands.)
strings.%s 님!! 그겁니다!! 당장 도망간 악덕 고용주를 잡아야…, 아니 사라: %s! That's it! We must catch that runaway, exploitative employer... I mean, find my missing senior Platina!
I think your true feelings slipped out. Something about an exploitative employer...
Not at all. She's my idol. You must have misheard.
strings.혹시 갔을 만한 곳을 알 수 있을까요?: Any idea where she might have gone?
Last time I saw her, she mentioned Jiendia and Mirgandia. Wait. Let me remember.
She said she'd visit a place called Song of the Coral and Monster Tree Mountain Valley.
I see. I'll look for her there.
strings.잠시만요. 가시는 김에 이 물건을 구해다 주시겠어요? 거기에 좋은 재료가: Wait. While you're there, could you get these? She said they have good ingredients.
Green Dragon Turtle Crystal and High-Grade Flour.
strings.네, 그럴게요. 알려줘서 고마워요!: I will. Thank you for the information!
strings.거기에 가도 플라티나는 보이지 않았어요. 대신 물건은 제대로 구해왔지만요: No sign of Platina. But I got the ingredients.
strings.감사해요. 진짜 선배는 대체 어딜 간 걸까요?: Thank you. Where on earth has she gone?
It must be that place. What was it called...?
strings.용의 모습을 한 신관들이 머물고 있는데, 거기는 함부로 들어갈 수 없다고: Priests in dragon form live there. She said you can't enter casually.
strings.플라티나 선배 정도 되는 홀리오더가 되어야 출입할 수 있나 봐요.(훌쩍): Apparently, you have to be a Holy Order like Platina to enter. Sniff.
A Temple Knight like me needs more training.
strings.그러고보니 거기서 모험가님을 만난 적이 있다고 했어요. 거기 아시죠? 아: Now I remember: she said she'd met you there. You know the place, right? Oh, I can't remember the name.
strings.(또 제나디아…. 그곳의 기억이 나질 않아…. ): (Xenadia again... I can't remember that place...)
strings.(제나디아의 기억이 흐릿하게 잔상처럼 남아있다.): (Memories of Xenadia linger like faint afterimages.)
strings.그곳에 플라티나가 있을 거라고 생각한 이유는 뭔가요?: Why do you think she'd be there?
strings.잘 모르겠지만, 그곳에서 생각을 정리하면 편해진다고 했던 말이 기억나서요: I'm not sure. But I remember her saying going there to gather her thoughts puts her at ease.
strings.그렇다고 복잡한 일이 가득한 성역에 돌아간 것도 아닐테고…. 이왕 수고스: She probably wouldn't return to the sanctuary, with all its complications... Could you make one more trip?
strings.네, 불쌍한 후배가 자금이 부족해서 사고 싶은 장비를 구하지도 못하고 있: Please tell her her poor junior is so short of money she can't buy the equipment she wants.
strings.여긴 아는 사람이 별로 없는 저만의 장소인데…. 아, %s 님도 잘 알고: This is my private spot. Few people know it... Though you know it well too, %s.
You look like you have no idea...
strings.(역시 폐하의 말씀대로 기억을 잃으셨구나….): (So the memories are gone, just as Her Majesty said...)
strings.흑흑, 설렜던 저와의 첫 만남을 기억하지 못하시는 건가요?: Sniff, sniff... You don't remember our thrilling first meeting?
strings.그건 아닌 것 같은데요.(정색): I don't think it was like that. (Deadpan.)
strings.그렇다고 정색하실 필요는 없잖아요!: You don't have to look so serious!
All right. Here's why I came...
strings.(소레이유와 세라가 찾고 있다고 플라티나에게 전한다.): (You tell Platina that Soleil and Sera are looking for her.)
strings.…아, 그랬군요. 모두에게 미안하네요. 매번 이렇게 소레이유가 찾게 하는: ...I see. I owe everyone an apology. Making Soleil search for me again, and causing worry over wages...
Don't worry! I'm Platina the paladin, after all.
strings.그런 것치고 너무 여유 넘치는 척하는 거 아닌가요?: For someone in that situation, aren't you acting a little too relaxed?
Ahahaha. Does it look that way? Sigh...
strings.제가 요즘 생각이 많아서요. 중요한 전투 전에는 항상 이곳에 와서 생각을: I've had a lot on my mind. Before an important battle, I always come here to collect my thoughts.
strings.안 그래도 폐하께서 부르실 때가 됐다고 생각했어요. 아마 이번엔 모험가님: I thought it was nearly time for Her Majesty to call me. You've probably received a message, too?
Lena said she'd deliver Her Majesty's decree in a few days.
I'm sure it's nothing serious. Don't worry.
strings.매번 다들 별 일 아니라고 했지만, 생각보다 큰일이었죠. 그래서 이번에도: Everyone says that, but it always turns out bigger than expected. I'm assuming the same this time.
strings.그런 여유라면 다 잘하실 거에요. 세라에게는 제가 금방 가서 급여를 지불: With that composure, you'll do fine. I'll go pay Sera soon. But I don't think I'll see Soleil for a while...
strings.제가 대신 전해야겠군요. 뭐라고 전할까요?: I'll pass on a message. What should I say?
strings.전해야 될 건 말이 아니라 물건인데…. 모험가님, 가는 길에 물건 하나만: It's an object, rather than a message... Could you get something on your way and take it to Soleil?
strings.최근에 미르간디아 지방에서 발견된 벨키아 왕국 책이에요. 소레이유가 평소: A book from the Kingdom of Belkia, recently discovered in Mirgandia. It should help with her research.
Look in the cemetery where Belkia's soldiers rest.
strings.알았어요, 플라티나. 그러면 생각 잘 정리하고 오세요. 저는 그럼 가볼게: All right, Platina. Take time to gather your thoughts. I'll be going.
Sigh... I wonder if Aurum is doing well...
Your light step tells me you found Platina.
I even sorted out the overdue wages.
strings.네? 아…. 길드 연합의 여관 말이군요. 플라티나가 오너니…. 그런데 손: Pardon? Ah... The Guild Alliance inn. Platina owns it... But what's in your hand?
It wasn't easy to find. The [Annals of the Kingdom of Belkia].
strings.(소레이유가 믿어지지 않는 표정으로 책과 %s의 모습을 번갈아 본다.): (Soleil looks between the book and %s in disbelief.)
strings.아니, 이걸 어떻게…. 말로만 들었지, 실물을 본 사람은 그동안 아무도: How did you...? I'd only heard of it. No one had seen the actual book. Even imperial explorers couldn't find it...
strings.엥? 그래요? 플라티나가 이 책이 최근에 발견됐다고, 구하는 대로 소레이: Really? Platina said it was recently discovered and asked me to bring it to you.
She does receive news from the imperial capital faster than I do.
Thank you. This will help my research greatly.
strings.실례가 안되면 무슨 내용인지 물어봐도 될까요?: If you don't mind, may I ask what you're researching?
It's complicated, but I'll explain briefly.
strings.각 대륙엔 위대한 마법사들이 있었어요. 프레이오스에도 대마법사 제레니스: Every continent had great mages. In Freios, besides Archmage Xerenis, there was a woman whose name is unknown.
strings.여러 마법사들이 자신의 세력과 국가를 위해서 쓰는 동안, 그분은 어느 곳: While other mages served their factions and nations, she belonged to none and fought for those who suffered.
strings.그 마법사와 함께한 소년 전사도 있었는데, 벨파 도서관의 어떤 책에 따르: A young warrior traveled with her. According to a book in Belpha Library, he later went to Eastland and became a Champion.
strings.마법사는 어느 순간 자취를 감췄는데, 그 전에 어떤 사람에게 자신의 뜻을: The mage eventually vanished, but first passed her wishes to someone: a young mage in the Kingdom of Belkia.
strings.하지만 청년 마법사는 위대한 마법사의 뜻을 따르지 않고, 국왕 레툼에게: He didn't follow her wishes. Instead, he informed King Letum and began studying her magic separately.
Letum is known as a virtuous king, but he also had powerful ambitions. During that research, they discovered something about the missing woman.
strings.프레이오스의 인간과 엘프를 비롯해 모든 마법사들이 쓸 수 없는 마법을 사: She had used magic no mage in Freios, human or elf, could wield.
strings.여기까지 제가 알고 있는 내용이에요. 이 이야기는 어디 가서 하시면 안: That's all I know. Please don't repeat it anywhere. The Magic Bureau especially mustn't learn more.
strings.…그것까지는 말씀드리지 못할 거 같아요. 죄송해요. 나중에 좀 더 알게: ...I can't tell you that. I'm sorry. I'll explain when I know more.
strings.궁금하긴 하지만, 어쩔 수 없죠. 이야기 고마워요, 소레이유. 그럼 전: I'm curious, but I understand. Thank you, Soleil. I'll be going. See you again.
